title: Power and bipower variation with stochastic volatility and jumps
access: Official web tool author-hosted PDF text; not downloaded raw PDF
finding: Under stated stochastic-volatility and rare-jump assumptions, normalized bipower variation targets the continuous variation component in an asymptotic limit. This does not certify jumps in a finite crypto candle sample. For r=s=1 the normal moment factor is mu_1^-2=pi/2.
Author bibliography lists Journal of Financial Econometrics 2, 1-48 with discussion. The inspected PDF is separately dated 2003-11-02; metadata does not make it a final 2004 PDF.
